compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
DD1 (pre-implementation): RED tests for provider interface structural compliance
DD3 (pre-implementation): RED test confirming MockProvider satisfies Provider Protocol

## TDD Requirement
Given/When/Then:
- Given: providers/base.py with Provider Protocol, providers/anthropic.py (existing)
- When: isinstance checks and method signature inspection
- Then: AnthropicProvider satisfies Provider Protocol; stub MockProvider has correct signature; providers/openai.py (not yet implemented) fails existence check (RED)

## Implementation
Create tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_unit.py asserting:
1. Provider Protocol exists at providers.base.Provider
2. AnthropicProvider structurally satisfies Protocol (has review_diff)  
3. Stub providers/mock.py exists with MockProvider.review_diff signature (stub only — raises NotImplementedError)
4. providers/openai.py does NOT yet exist (confirms RED state before T2)

Also create stub providers/mock.py:
  class MockProvider:
      def review_diff(self, diff_text: str, **kwargs) -> dict: raise NotImplementedError("S2 implementation pending")

.test-index: add RED marker [test_openai_provider_review_diff] for providers/openai.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh completes (RED marker exempts openai tests)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] test_providers_unit.py exists with structural compliance tests
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_unit.py && grep -q "def test_" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_unit.py
- [ ] providers/mock.py stub exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/providers/mock.py
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for openai.py
  Verify: grep '\[test_openai_provider_review_diff\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
